data.long_meaning: Adhik is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Adhika' which means 'Lord' or 'Master'. In Hindu mythology, Adhik is believed to be the name of various gods and deities. The name Adhik is considered auspicious and is often given to boys to signify their position as the head of the family or community.
